messages:
Amanda K: Hey team — proposing a 30-min dry-run with KiteCorp to walk the on‑prem install and handoff. Thinking Tue 10:00am PST (Mar 2). Draft agenda: 1) preflight checklist, 2) network/topology walkthrough, 3) KMS/HSM key handoff, 4) rollback & postmortem plan, 5) owners/actions. Who can join?
Jorge: I can do Tue 10. Please add 'verify NTP and cert chains' to preflight.
Li: Heads up I'm OOO Tue morning, can do Wed 11am PST or Tue after 1pm.
Colin: I can cover ingress/NAT/firewall rules. If Tue must be 10am I can join first 20m.
Devon (CS): I'll invite KiteCorp infra lead Marie and the account exec. @Marie, you good for Tue 10?
Marie (KiteCorp): Tue 10 PST works for us. Can we include a quick demo of the install dry-run logs?
Amanda K: Great — adding demo to agenda (5m). Noted Li conflict — if majority prefers Wed we can pivot.
Jorge: SGTM. Also let's make sure the install script runs against a sandbox VPC first. Use flag `--sandbox=true` during the dry run.
Colin: Quick firewall snippet I'll share in the call:```
# example iptables block for management plane
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8443 -j DROP
```
Devon (CS): Added KMS rotation + cert expiry checks to agenda per Marie's ask.
Amanda K: Updated agenda in the runbook and added owners. Owners: preflight -> Jorge, network -> Colin, KMS -> Li, rollback -> Amanda.
Jorge: I'll prep the preflight checklist and paste a short checklist in #eng-infra before the call.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: Tue Mar 2 10:00am PST — Zoom + dial-in included. Invite: https://zoom.redwood.example/meet/xyz123
Li: If we do Wed 11, I can take KMS and run the HSM key handoff demo. If Tue stays, I'll send a pre-recorded snippet.
Amanda K: OK plan: keep Tue for now since KiteCorp confirmed. Li please post pre-recorded snippet in thread by EOD Mon if you can't make it live.
Colin: :thumbsup: I'll also bring the NAT gateway failover diagram.
Devon (CS): I'll send the attendee list and pre-call checklist to KiteCorp and cc owners.
Amanda K: Thanks all — meeting notes template uploaded to the runbook. I'll post the final agenda and action items 1h before the call. :rocket:
